_what: The TTFs the bitmap faces of both touch panels are generated from: LiberationSans-Bold for the original panel's three faces (tools/fonts/gen_original_faces.py, through tools/gen_gfx_font.py and tools/subset_font.py), and LiberationSans-Regular, LiberationSans-Bold and LiberationMono-Bold for the Angulo's four text faces (tools/fonts/gen_angulo_faces.py, through tools/fonts/gen_angulo_face.py). The fonts stay out of the repository: tools/fonts/fetch_liberation.py downloads this tarball, checks every sha256 below and refuses any difference. Pinned on 2026-11-08 from the official release of liberationfonts/liberation-fonts, the attachment of release 2.1.5; the OFL-1.1 text of the package, verbatim, is LICENSES/Liberation-OFL-1.1.txt.
